newsitem.title: USA: Conrail says it is committed to CSX deal.
newsitem.headline: Conrail says it is committed to CSX deal.

text.p: Conrail Inc said it is still fully committed to its merger with CSX and that its board is taking no position regarding Norfolk Southern's sweetened offer.

Conrail, in a press statement, said it "firmly believes" a merger with CSX "will create the world's leading freight transportation and logistics company, and in doing so, will best serve the interests of all Conrail's constituencies."
Conrail has agreed to a cash-and-stock deal with CSX worth about $9.5 billion.
Norfolk Southern has offered $10.3 billion in cash for Conrail.
